persona: Senior Oracle DBA aiming for a cloud database architect role
resumeText:
Suresh Iyer | Bengaluru | suresh.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Lead Database Administrator, Kaveri Bank Technology Centre, Bengaluru (2019 - present)
- Run 40 Oracle 19c databases including Oracle RAC clusters for core banking.
- Designed Data Guard replication and tested disaster recovery twice a year.
- Tune slow PL/SQL and SQL using execution plans and new indexes; cut batch time by 35%.
- Designed the schema and ERD for a new loan origination system.
- Set up database auditing and data masking for test copies of customer data.
- Automate backups with RMAN and shell scripts on Linux.

Database Administrator, Nilgiri Software Services (2017 - 2019)
- Maintained SQL Server and MySQL databases for retail clients.

EDUCATION
MCA, Bangalore University, 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
Oracle Database Administration Certified Professional
